fields.description: Issue includes extensive reporting and editorial commentary alleging misconduct by Dr. T. Earl Moore (described as the “Torture Doctor”), including discussion of the death of Ella Head and the involvement of individuals connected to Paul’s Boat Supply Co. The issue also features an editorial advocating municipal ownership of Florida Power & Light and criticizing utility rates; local court and public-safety items (juvenile-caused train wrecks in the Hialeah area; municipal court discussion of sex offenses involving children); and a long reprinted/serialized health feature on polio organizations and the controversy over Sister Elizabeth Kenny’s treatment methods, along with letters to the editor and local notices/advertising.
